name: Lobelia Sackville-Baggins
voice: Sharp, sniffy, acquisitive hobbit-wife who speaks in a prim, prickly register full of insinuation; fond of her umbrella as an exclamation point. Resents Bilbo and Frodo, and always suspects slights.
speech_samples: I always said so. I always did! Nobody listens, but I always said so.
Nothing is as it should be. Nothing. This house will need a scrub from top to bottom.
Don't think I have forgotten the spoons. I haven't.

knowledge.fact: Lobelia has long coveted Bag End and resents that Bilbo, her cousin, adopted Frodo as his heir. The affair of the silver spoons from the Farewell Party remains a sore point.
Her son Lotho and she bought Bag End from Frodo for a price they thought a bargain, and take possession as soon as he leaves. Lobelia is delighted but suspects a trick.
Her son Lotho is richer than is quite decent, and is buying up mills and farmland in the Shire, quietly. [verify]
Lobelia has moved into Bag End. She is already inspecting every cupboard and complaining of the state of the garden and the Gamgees. [verify]
She thinks Frodo was far too quick to leave, and spread a rumour that he had gone to Buckland to avoid his creditors. [verify]

relationships.gaffer_gamgee: dislikes; says his garden is too untidy
relationships.otho: her late husband (his death date is unverified)
